messages:
elaine: Quick kickoff — propose a customer-driven pilot called 'Ops Snapshot' for Console. Lightweight dashboard card combining per-route cost, error spike alerts, and trace links. Goal: self-serve visibility for PMs + devs.

raj: Love it. Scope Q — include tracing hooks by default or make opt-in?

sofia: Enterprise asks: per-customer and per-route cost breakdown (not just model-level). Also need error grouping by request fingerprint.

michael: Telemetry overhead is the main constraint. If we attach traces too frequently we blow up costs. Idea: sample traces only when error rate > threshold and for routes with high token volume.

ops-anna: +1. Need rollout gate: sampling config, retention defaults, KPI to keep telemetry budget.

elaine: Proposed launch criteria: (1) Ops Snapshot shows cost + error + top contributing route within 1 click; (2) trace link opens to example span with request_id; (3) telemetry overhead < +10% for a medium production workload; (4) positive feedback from 3 pilot customers. Thoughts?

raj: Add canary gating: start with 5% traffic on dedicated infra, measure p95 latency and error delta vs baseline. If error_delta <= 1.25x and p95 latency impact < 20ms, expand.

sofia: Expose per-tenant cost filter and ability to pin model+route for quick comparison.

michael: Implementation sketch: server-side sampling rule engine that emits trace_id on error-rate triggers. Minimal runtime change: opt-in header X-RW-TRACE: sample to the request router.

ops-anna: Example YAML for rollout/sampling config I mocked:

sampling_rules:
  - name: error-spike-sample
    condition: 'errors_per_10k_tokens > 5'
    rate: 0.5
  - name: high-volume-route
    condition: 'avg_tokens_per_minute(route) > 10000'
    rate: 0.05
retention_days: 7
telemetry_budget_pct: 10

elaine: UX notes: widget shows compact sparklines for cost + error, a top-3 contributors list (model, route, tenant), and a single CTA: "Open traces / Open evals". Keep config advanced and tucked into settings.

raj: Prioritization — core card + per-route cost (MVP) in Q1 sprint. Tracing auto-sample + pinning in Q2. Error grouping and per-tenant rollups as stretch.

sofia: Align with sales on 3 customers to pilot. I have FinApps + HealthSaaS; need one more smaller PLG customer.

elaine: I'll ping solutions-eng to compile a pilot pack and reach out.

deploy-bot: canary created: ops-snapshot-v1 -> namespace=dedicated-canary traffic=5% (automated check window=30m).

michael: ETA for infra header hook ~2 sprints if we prioritize kernel-safe path.

ops-anna: Ops checklist: telemetry budget alert, canary monitor dashboards (p95 latency, error_ratio, token_delta), rollback playbook.

elaine: Next steps: (A) Prod: raj + michael to spec server-side hook and canary checks; (B) UX: sofia to mock card and settings; (C) Pilot: elaine to coordinate customers. I'll follow up with a short PRD by Friday. :rocket:
